stages_hint: Each expense line from what is planned to what is still available: reserved for a spending not yet committed, committed to a third party and not yet charged, and actual: charged, that is the obligations recognised, including payments owed and not yet paid.
stages_empty: No expense line is in force for this period.
unadopted_hint: Lines still being drafted or proposed show what they plan and nothing else: no money can be reserved, committed or charged to them before they are adopted.
payments_hint: Payments the realm owes: no money has moved yet. Each is paid by its due date, or revoked unpaid and cancelled.
payments_empty_all: The realm has no scheduled payments.
payments_empty_month: No payment falls due this month.
payment_show_line: Show this line among the spending stages
sweeps_rules_hint: At the end of each treasury epoch a quarter moves what its fund holds, all but the amount it keeps, into the capital's fund.
sweeps_rules_empty: The capital has set no sweep rules: its quarters keep what they receive.
sweeps_history_restricted: Only those who may read the treasury see the sweeps.
sweeps_empty: No sweep has been recorded yet.
stages_line_gone: That line is no longer among the lines in force: a later budget amended it, or its period has closed.
stage_owed: of which owed, not yet paid: {amount}
